prompt:
LOCAL GOURD ORIENTATION AND ARM POSE correction of this exact green sprout healer. Keep her identity, face, hairstyle, proportions, green/ivory outfit, standing direction, skirt, shoes, sachet, colors and clean project icon style.

REVERSE THE GOURD'S DIRECTION and make it truly REST SIDEWAYS ON ONE FOREARM:
In the input the stoppered mouth points LEFT. In the new image, the stopper/mouth and SMALL UPPER BULB must point SCREEN RIGHT; the LARGE ROUND BELLY is toward SCREEN LEFT/center. It lies nearly HORIZONTALLY across the supporting forearm at waist/lower-chest height, not upright, not tilted steeply and not pressed vertically against chest.
Maintain the current enlarged gourd size, warm brown two-bellied shape, green waist cord and one leaf mark. Rotate/repaint it organically, don't mirror the whole character. The large belly's weight rests visibly on the forearm, with continuous contact over a meaningful length, rather than balancing on fingertips.

SUPPORT ARM:
The nearer arm on SCREEN RIGHT bends at its elbow close to her side. Its FOREARM crosses horizontally under the gourd toward screen-left and forms a visible supportive shelf. The hand at the screen-left end cups the far/lower rounded belly, fingers naturally curled around its underside. Show the sleeve fold and forearm direction clearly enough to understand how the weight is held. The elbow, wrist and hand must belong to one continuous arm. No duplicated hands or impossible wrap.

FREE ARM:
The other arm on SCREEN LEFT is not touching the gourd. Move it from the stiff straight hanging pose into a relaxed gentle conversational gesture: elbow mildly bent, forearm a little forward/down at hip level, wrist straight and fingers loosely curved together with a small natural separation. Palm angled inward/up just slightly, calm and unforced. No pointing finger, claw, clenched fist, pinching skirt or wide waving. Keep visible clear space between this free hand and the supporting hand/gourd, and make both connect to their respective sleeves.
Both shoulders remain relaxed, small natural asymmetry, no change to legs or overall standing pose. Exactly TWO arms and hands, only one arm supports the gourd.

Maintain broad matte color/value planes and clean dark outlines, minimal prop decoration, no glassy highlights or tiny facets. Same full-body square image, all leaf tips and feet visible, plain warm ivory background, no new props/text/crop.
purpose: Reverse gourd to mouth-right, resting sideways across one forearm; relax the free hand into a gentle bent-elbow gesture.
